verdicts.citation: SPEC.md 6.4 'Names in rank 2' (unlabelled): 'This adjustment is made by `satake_record` (engine: `satakeRecord`); the plain function `satake` would say `B2`.' SPEC.md Appendix H, Rules: 'Satake records for display come from satakeRecord, which applies the C2 naming of SPEC 6.4.' Both sentences support the finding's expected. decisions/P6-A3.md 'P6-A3: the C2 drawing rule' and DECISIONS.md 'MERGE: P6 stage 6.2, P6-A3 (T13 Satake Studio)' ruling (1) record which record decides the drawing. They do not record an exemption from 6.4 or Appendix H for applying the adjustment in site code.
verdicts.evidence: I read everything in the worktree, detached at f07eec6; git status --porcelain was empty before and after. (1) site/src/components/tools/t13/model.ts lines 443-448, in assembleData: `if (r.restricted_type_display === 'C2' && restrictedBoardName === 'B2' && order !== null) { restrictedBoardName = 'C2'; order = order.reverse(); }`. It is applied to satake(d)'s restricted_board and restricted_orbits_in_bourbaki_order. The records from matchCatalogue (satakeRecord output) are read only for real_form, cartan_label and restricted_type_display. This matches the finding's observed. (2) SPEC 6.4 'Names in rank 2' has no [D] and no 'may'. The only [D] on rank-2 names is in 2.8 (line 319: the 'B2=C2' display). D19 (section 10) covers picker names and the 'B2=C2' note, not where the Satake adjustment is made. (3) SPEC 4 T13 (phase 6): 'Restricted board: drawn in Bourbaki order (`restricted_orbits_in_bourbaki_order`)', and names come from `matchCatalogue`. SPEC 5.3 has the row `satakeRecord(name, entry)`: 'the complete record of section 6.4 ... and the C2 adjustment described there'. CONTRACTS 2.4 has `satakeRecord(name: string, entry: SatakeCatalogueEntry): SatakeRecord`. (4) Plan instruction P6-A3 5.6 directs the site-side adjustment ('when the record you draw by has restricted_type_display C2, name the restricted board C2 and reverse ...; Record the rule; it is an open question for the orchestrator'). Its own trap list (section 9) says 'The C2 adjustment is satakeRecord's, not satake's'. (5) decisions/P6-A3.md line 22 records the rule ('Default used: the plan's (instruction 5.6)'). It names as left open only 'which record decides the drawing when two match'. (6) P6-A3.json openQuestions: 'C2 drawing rule: draw by the record whose pair is the reader's, else the first record (D4 black 3, 4: so(2,6), B2).' MERGE ruling (1): 'the C2 drawing rule stands (the record whose pair is the reader's, else the first record; on D4 black 3, 4 so(2,6), drawn B2)'. The question and the ruling are both about which record decides. The finding does not contest that. (7) The 'Note for T13' in 'MERGE: P6-A1 reviewed' is about laying the board out by labels and says nothing on where the C2 adjustment lives. (8) The known-and-decided list in P6-LENS-INSTRUCTIONS.md does not name the C2 rule. reports/gate-G6.md (from the integration branch) names f07eec6 as the gate commit and has no open item on it. There is no earlier P6 red-team merge report. I read the reproducer as text: test 1 greps model.ts for the C2 branch; test 2 compares assembleData with satakeRecord on the reader's pair.
verdicts.reason: not refuted: R1 failed: 6.4 and Appendix H are unqualified, and T13's spec text names the record field. R2 failed: the finding quotes both sentences correctly, and assembleData does build the displayed restricted_board and Bourbaki orbits itself. R3 failed: T13 and satakeRecord are phase 6 and the gate is G6. R4 failed: the finding concedes every value is right, so there is no value for the oracle to settle. R5 failed: the sentence is not [D], the default is the plan's (not a section 10 default and not the owner's answer), and the logged decision and MERGE ruling (1) settle only which record decides the drawing, not the second implementation of the adjustment in site code; a plan-directed departure from an unlabelled rule is not covered (RT-VERIFY 5.4). R6 failed: no gate item or earlier-round record. Minor fits: values are right, the duplication is structural.

verdicts.citation: SPEC.md 5.1 E-7 (no [D] in 5.1 apart from E-2): 'Everything outside the engine uses labels ... Two functions, toLabels and toPositions, convert node lists and words; nothing else converts.' The sentence supports the finding's expected. Precedents at the gate commit: DECISIONS.md T9 entry fixing finding P3-RT-02-02 ('instead of reading index label - 1 of a list in label order'; Reason: E-7, 'nothing else converts') and the T11 repair entry ('instead of labels.indexOf(k + 1)', 'j + 1 printed as the label').
verdicts.evidence: I confirmed every cited line at f07eec6. model.ts:521 `${k + 1}: (${a}, ${b})`; 527 `drawing.orbits[k - 1]`; 528 `drawing.pairs[k - 1]`; 534 `data.drawing!.orbits[k - 1]`; 732 `drawing.orbitIndex[k - 1]`; 859 `at node ${k + 1}`; 875 `at node ${k + 1}`. T13SatakeStudio.svelte:220 `drawn.labels.map((l) => String(coords[l - 1]!))`; 224 `coords[l - 1]`; 226 `data.drawing!.pairs[l - 1]`; 932 `drawnPairs[l - 1]`; 933 `coords[l - 1]`. Here `drawn` is boardFromName of the restricted name, and the arrays are in its Bourbaki or position order, so each line converts a drawn-board label to a position (or back) by hand. RestrictedBoardView.svelte imports and uses toLabels and toPositions (lines 9, 44, 53, 55), as the finding says. E-7's table defines restricted-board labels as 1..m in Bourbaki order. It gives no exception to 'nothing else converts'. The P6-A3 instruction 5.9 says 'its node with label k standing for the orbit restricted_orbits_in_bourbaki_order[k-1]', and decisions/P6-A3.md 'the C2 drawing rule' says 'its node with label k stands for the k-th orbit of the record's Bourbaki list'. Both define the mapping, not the method. The same instruction's trap list says 'toLabels and toPositions are the only converters'. The 'Note for T13' in 'MERGE: P6-A1 reviewed' says 'lay the restricted board out by its labels, not by its name', which does not permit by-hand arithmetic. The project has already treated index arithmetic over a list in label or Bourbaki order as an E-7 conversion (P3-RT-02-02 on T9, confirmed and fixed; the T11 repair). RT-02 lens file section 6: 'A conversion written as board.labels[k] that gives the right value: report as minor only, citing E-7's nothing else converts'. The known-and-decided list says nothing on this. gate-G6 has no item on it, and there is no earlier P6 round record.
verdicts.reason: not refuted: R1 failed: E-7's 'nothing else converts' has no qualifier and no [D]. R2 failed: the lines turn drawn-board labels into indices of position-ordered arrays and back, which the project's own precedents (P3-RT-02-02, the T11 repair) treat as E-7 conversions. R3 failed: T13 is phase 6 and the gate is G6. R4 failed: no value disagreement (every value is right, as the finding says). R5 failed: decisions/P6-A3.md and plan 5.9 record the label-k-to-k-th-orbit mapping, not an exemption from toLabels/toPositions, and the same plan calls them the only converters. R6 failed: no record. Minor matches the lens rubric for a by-hand conversion that gives the right value.
